name: jakeresume-monorepo
description: JakeResume Builder – Vercel monorepo (Vite SPA + Express serverless API)

scripts.build: cd client && (npm ci --legacy-peer-deps || npm install --legacy-peer-deps) && npm run build
scripts.test: cd server && npm run test:milestone1 && npm run test:google-auth && npm run test:backend-hardening && cd ../client && npm run test:all
scripts.verify: cd client && npm run lint && npm run test:all && npm run build && cd ../server && npm test && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
